purpose: Restrained architectural photography-style AI design inspiration

images.prompt: Use case: photorealistic-natural. Create a landscape 3:2 photograph for an architectural lighting website. It must look like a real professional architectural photograph, NOT a render, fantasy, holiday greeting card or AI illustration. Restrained documentary editorial architecture photography, full-frame camera, tilt-shift lens with straight verticals, realistic exposure, natural neutral white balance, subtle sensor grain, detailed but not sharpened excessively. Ordinary overcast winter twilight just before sunset, enough ambient daylight to read materials; small warm-white bulbs clearly visible but not glowing blobs. Light patchy residual snow only on lawn edges and planting beds, no falling snow. No orange windows, no exaggerated golden illumination, no teal/orange grading, no halos, no saturated blue sky, no bloom, no starbursts. Realistic attainable professionally installed exterior Christmas decorations. No people, cars, text, logo, watermark or collage. Compose whole subject comfortably within frame; premium but understated Northern Virginia residential architecture. Subject: a handsome two-story pale painted brick house with dark slate gabled roof and a simple stone entry, photographed from street at a mild oblique angle, quiet bare winter trees. Meticulously aligned small warm-white C9 bulbs trace only roof edges and gables, restrained subtle brightness. No decorated trees or giant Christmas props. Some windows dark, others softly lit with believable curtains. Real masonry texture, minor weathering, roof geometry accurate. Architectural roof silhouette is focus.
